title: Triangulation obstructions in dimension five
mathematical_results: For closed connected topological five-manifolds, simplicial nontriangulability is equivalent to evaluation of w1 cup Kirby-Siebenmann equal to one.
Every product of a closed connected topological four-manifold with a circle is simplicially triangulable.
The characteristic number multiplies by covering degree modulo two; every connected even-degree finite cover in dimension five is triangulable.

For orientable four-dimensional fibers, the mapping-torus characteristic number equals orientation-reversal parity times the Kirby-Siebenmann invariant, and asphericity is equivalent to fiber asphericity.
Every mapping torus of a closed oriented spin topological four-manifold is triangulable.
remaining_gap: Construct an aspherical closed five-manifold with the nonzero characteristic number, or prove that number always vanishes for aspherical five-manifolds.
